note: DeepPAC: scenario-learned affine PAC model gives (eta,epsilon)-PAC-model robustness in Linf ball; probability over uniform sampling of the ball, not strictly forall.
WMLR mixed linear regression: w.p. 1-delta generalization bound, sample complexity linear in dimension; GDA convergence (ALG) is co-headline.
MixTrain: verifiably robust training; symbolic linear relaxation certifies Linf robustness per test input (VRA up to 95.2%); VRA aggregate is test-set rate.
LCIFR: MILP certifies individual fairness, all similar individuals (attribute/noise similarity set) get same label; tabular classifier coded perception, doubtful.
FedOT: w.p. 1-delta generalization bound for personalized federated classifier under client distribution shifts; GDA convergence (ALG) also proved.
